📺 Degrassi: The Next Generation (2001–2015)

Degrassi: The Next Generation follows a group of teenagers attending Degrassi Community School in Toronto, Canada, as they navigate the emotional challenges of growing up, friendship, romance, and family life. The series centers on students including Emma Nelson, Manny Santos, Paige Michalchuk, Spinner Mason, Jimmy Brooks, and Craig Manning, whose lives become intertwined through relationships, heartbreak, rivalries, and unexpected challenges. From first love and complicated friendships to bullying, mental health struggles, family conflicts, and difficult personal decisions, the students experience the realities of adolescence while learning valuable lessons about responsibility and acceptance. Featuring memorable performances from a talented young cast, including a young Drake as Jimmy Brooks, the series became one of television’s most recognizable teen dramas, delivering emotional storylines, unforgettable characters, and powerful messages about identity, friendship, resilience, and growing up.

🎭 Genre: Teen Drama • Romance • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 7.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creators: Linda Schuyler & Yan Moore

📺 Seasons: 14 • 385 Episodes

📚 Part Of: The Canadian Degrassi television franchise.

🏆 Awards: Winner of multiple Canadian television awards and a Peabody Award.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Tubi, HBO Max, and Amazon Prime Video for current streaming availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Degrassi: The Next Generation (re-titled to Degrassi for seasons 10 to 14) is a Canadian teen drama television series created by Yan Moore and Linda Schuyler. It is the fourth series in the Degrassi franchise and a revival of Degrassi Junior High and Degrassi High. It premiered on CTV on October 14, 2001, and concluded on August 2, 2015, on MTV Canada. The series centers around a new ensemble cast of students at the fictional Degrassi Community School who face challenges such as sex, teen pregnancy, bullying, date rape, drug abuse, body image, homosexuality, domestic violence, gang violence, self-injury, suicide, abortion, mental disorders, and others.
